title: Stubai Full Catalog Curation - normalized model migration
summary: Migrates PR #10 onto the normalized Snowcast catalog. Facts are assigned to explicit regions, stay destinations, stay bases, ski areas, access edges, terrain domains, pass products, and rental facts. Source-aware v2 enrichment follow-up: Reviewed Stubai Glacier, Fulpmes, and Neustift facts against official operator and Stubai tourism sources. Added snowmaking availability, glacier terrain, Stubai Zoo, explicit overnight closure, seven marked ski routes, the current official piste map, ski-day apres, both village elevations and character profiles, and local apres facts.

ranking_impact_summary: Ranking-relevant facts now attach to the normalized ski-area, stay-base, and access-edge owners; Search V3 scoring policy is unchanged.
unresolved_caveats: Official Stubai pages did not yet publish a reviewed 2026/27 winter skiing window during this sweep; exact season_windows record the latest reviewed 2025/26 winter window.
Official terrain data distinguishes 65 km fall-line distance from 108 km effective route distance; total_piste_km stores the 108 km user-facing effective route distance.
Difficulty-km split remains unset because the source includes ski routes and infrastructure categories that do not map cleanly to the current beginner/intermediate/advanced model.
Destination-level coordinates and base elevation remain product-normalized for the glacier-plus-valley destination; exact stay-base identities are now captured with OSM relation IDs.
Accommodation and rental price ranges remain product-curated estimates until a provider sampling policy is reviewed.
Source-aware v2 enrichment follow-up: The official piste map identifies a snowmaking system but publishes no coverage percentage or denominator.
Source-aware v2 enrichment follow-up: The seven marked ski routes are distinct from the operator's ten unsecured Powder Department freeride runs; only the marked ski-route inventory is counted.

Source-aware v2 enrichment follow-up: Fulpmes and Neustift local apres values are based on official village venue and winter-program inventories and are classified moderate rather than destination-defining.
